title: Kaiserschmarrn (Emperor Pancake)
description: Austria's famous torn pancake — high-protein version with skyr, casein/whey blend and egg, torn into caramelised pieces.
steps: Whisk eggs, yogurt, protein powder, milk and a pinch of salt until combined.
Melt butter in a pan on medium; pour in all batter at once.
Cook until bottom is golden; flip onto a plate then back into pan.
Cook other side 2 minutes. Use spatula to tear into bite-sized pieces.
Fry pieces 1 more minute tossing for extra colour.
notes: For extra fluffiness: separate eggs, beat whites to stiff peaks, fold into yolk batter before cooking.
